dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-body region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slightly asymmetrical lateral margins with a more pronounced convex bulge on the right-hand margin compared to the left.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone with high median pixel intensity and minimal shading across the primary dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Thin, low-contrast linear white markings visible on the posterior dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Shadow-casting longitudinal line along the central dorsal axis indicating a prominent ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of fine linear markings on the posterior peduncle region.
